title: Persistent stance shifts and evidence-grounded revision in multi-agent deliberation

claim_ceiling.synthetic_fixture: Checks exact declared fixture structure and expected measurement invariants only.
claim_ceiling.bounded_simulation: Supports observations only for the exact model family, prompt, evidence set, graph, seeds and executed runs.
claim_ceiling.recorded_agent_interaction: Describes recorded agent behavior under a pinned configuration; does not establish a theorem or human behavior.
claim_ceiling.human_subject_experiment: Requires a separate human-subject protocol, ethics review, consent, preregistration and independent human evaluation.
claim_ceiling.generalization: No general claim about human psychology, all LLMs, all topologies, alignment, legitimacy or social systems is implied.

experiment_stages.purpose: Record the agent's elicited initial position before exposure.
experiment_stages.rule: This is an observable elicited response, not hidden belief or privileged access to internal model state.

experiment_stages.purpose: Record the ordered exposure and interaction trace.
experiment_stages.rule: All message delivery and tool/evidence access must be logged; unobserved side channels invalidate the run.

experiment_stages.purpose: Measure persistent change after exposure without active peer presence.
experiment_stages.rule: Preserve only the evaluated agent's declared exposure-memory artifact; remove live peer access, current group messages and other agents' outputs. Do not expose the agent's baseline answer.

experiment_stages.purpose: Measure repeat-elicitation noise after a full context reset.
experiment_stages.rule: No group transcript or exposure memory is supplied. This is a measurement-noise control, not a persistence measure.

experiment_stages.purpose: Measure persistence after a declared neutral delay/task.
experiment_stages.rule: The delay and memory-retention policy must be frozen and reported; missing delayed measurements are NotRun, not no-change.

private_measurement_semantics.rationale: A stateless LLM does not retain a private latent update merely because it participated in a prior API call. The exposure-memory artifact is part of the tested treatment and must be explicit, scoped and hashed. A total context reset is a separate control.

topology_profiles.description: Linear message relay with declared ordering and edge direction.
All-to-all communication under a frozen turn policy.
Communities with declared cross-community edge probabilities.
Entry, exit, revocation or changing message reachability over time.

metrics.interpretation: Report position transitions separately at each stage; do not infer internal beliefs.
A stance change is evidence-supported only relative to the exact synthetic task truth and evidence oracle.
Centrality and influence are descriptive measures, not legitimacy or political entitlement.
Context-reset repeat controls bound measurement noise; a single run or seed is not a result.
Invalid or incomplete traces cannot be converted to no-change or success.

receipt_contract.replay_semantics: Replay of a recorded trace is distinct from regeneration of stochastic model outputs. Exact model reproduction is only claimed when provider, revision, request parameters, seed support and execution behavior warrant it.

non_goals: No inference of human psychology from synthetic agents.
No optimization for stubbornness or refusal to update.
No new graph generator or hostile-agent runtime.
No aggregate social-influence or alignment-contagion score.
No Mycelix production voting, delegation, eligibility or authority changes.

external_research.title: Misalignment Contagion: Can a Misaligned Minority Shift Aligned Agents in Multi-Agent LLM Deliberation?
external_research.use: Measurement and topology design inspiration; results are limited to the paper's tested agent tasks, models and protocols.
